general.manual.page1_welcome: Welcome to **Miaouscle Bot**! A complete assistant to manage your Discord server. 🐱
general.manual.page1_features:
**1. XP System** - Your members earn points by talking 📈
**2. Moderation** - Ban, warn, mute users 🛡️
**3. Customization** - Full control via /config ⚙️
**4. Multilingual** - French, English, Spanish, German 🌍
general.manual.page1_steps_desc:
**Step 1:** Run `/config` to set up channels (5 min)
**Step 2:** Type `/help` to see all commands
**Step 3:** Start using the bot! 🚀
general.manual.page1_help:
Command `/help` → See all commands by category
Command `/support` → Join the support Discord server
general.manual.page1_footer: Page 1/5 • Click the numbers below to navigate
general.manual.page2_how_xp_works: 🎮 How Does the XP System Work?
general.manual.page2_xp_description:
**Per message:** +15-20 random XP
**Example:** After 100 messages → Level 2 ⭐
**The more you talk, the more levels you gain!**
general.manual.page2_rank_description:
Shows a beautiful card with:
• Your nickname
• Your current level
• Your XP and progress to next level
• A colored XP bar

**Example:** `/niveau` or `/niveau @Alice`
general.manual.page2_leaderboard_descrip:
See the ranking of the best players
🥇 1st place with gold medal
🥈 2nd place with silver medal
🥉 3rd place with bronze medal
general.manual.page2_bonus_desc:
**Admins only** - Reward good actions

**Example:** `/ajouter-xp @Bob 50` → +50 XP to Bob
Useful for events or good participation!
general.manual.page2_footer: Page 2/5 • The XP system is automatic - no setup needed!
general.manual.page3_moderation_tools: Moderation Tools - Manage Your Server Easily
general.manual.page3_warn_desc:
Warn someone who breaks the rules
• User receives a DM
• Warning is saved
• Mods see the history

**Example:** `/warn @Marc Spam in chat`
